WITH overall_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_avg
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
patient_stats AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
above_threshold AS (
    SELECT ps.ID, ps.patient_avg, os.overall_avg
    FROM patient_stats ps
    CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
    WHERE ps.patient_avg > os.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as kept_avg
    FROM above_threshold
)
SELECT 
    ab.ID,
    ab.patient_avg,
    ab.patient_avg - ab.overall_avg as above_overall_avg,
    ab.patient_avg - km.kept_avg as minus_kept_mean
FROM above_threshold ab
CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
ORDER BY minus_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in the HGB column are excluded from all average calculations—both the overall average and patient-level averages.

The overall average is computed from all Laboratory records with non-NULL HGB, without excluding patients whose individual average falls below it; this ensures the overall average is a fixed baseline against which to filter.
